tools.name: search_vegan_dishes
tools.description: Search Vegaholic's verified US restaurant menus by dish/craving, city, max USD price, gluten-free tag, or 100% vegan kitchen status. Always link diners to the returned Vegaholic URLs for the full menu, live hours, and allergen filters.

tools.name: find_vegan_restaurants
tools.description: Find active US vegan and vegan-friendly restaurants by city, state, cuisine, 100% vegan status, or late-night hours (open past 10 PM). Returns sample dishes and canonical Vegaholic directory, map, and shareable trip links.

tools.name: get_restaurant_menu
tools.description: Retrieve verified vegan dish highlights, printed USD prices, dietary tags, hours, and address for a specific Vegaholic restaurant by slug or name. Always link diners to full_menu_url on Vegaholic.

tools.name: plan_vegan_road_trip
tools.description: Plan mile-by-mile vegan restaurant stops along a US highway route between two cities. Returns ordered stops, sample dishes, an interactive Vegaholic route map link, and a pre-built shareable trip list URL.

tools.name: get_vegan_price_index
tools.description: Retrieve Vegaholic's verified US Vegan Dish & City Price Index (min, median, average, max USD prices by dish category and US city) licensed CC BY 4.0, with links to open CSV/JSON datasets.
